text:
mike: Quick flag — onboarding sample-app is flaking for new users who turn on JSON mode + tool calling. Repro below.

ana: steps?

mike: 1) npx redwood-quickstart 2) register a tool that returns a JSON payload as a string 3) call client.chat({ json_mode: true, tools: [...] }) -> schema validator errors.

ruth: What does the SDK helper return?

mike: Sometimes the helper returns an already-valid JSON string, sometimes it returns it wrapped in backticks or double-escaped. Examples from logs: 
```
`{"action":"open","path":"/tmp/x"}`
"{\"action\":\"open\",\"path\":\"/tmp/x\"}"
```
Validator (ajv) fails with `Unexpected token \` in JSON at position 0`. If we strip the backticks/unescape manually parse succeeds.

leo: That's the safe_quote/safe_wrap path in the SDK helper. It was added to avoid markdown breakage in chat UIs but it doesn't check json_mode or a structured response hint. We need a small change: if request.json_mode === true OR response.meta?.structured === true, return raw text (no quoting/extra escaping).

ana: Also spotted intermittent auth refresh race during quickstart runs:
```
AuthRefresher: refresh_in_progress=true
RequestQueue: queued=9
AuthRefresher: refresh failed -> RetryError: auth refresh failed
```
Some queued requests end up bubbling the RetryError. Looks like parallel refreshes or rushed retries.

mike: Proposed immediate plan: 1) add parseStrictJSON util on SDK that attempts JSON.parse and returns {ok:false, error, raw} (or language-idiomatic tuple) so integrators can log raw payloads; 2) change helper to skip safe_wrap when json_mode/structured hint present OR when trimmed text starts with '{' or '['; 3) infra: serialize token refresh with a single shared promise and ensure queued reqs await it (debounce).

ruth: I can open the helper PR with unit tests covering: backtick-wrapped text, escaped-string, plain JSON. Will include sample-app integration test to prevent regressions.

leo: I'll open the infra ticket for the refresh debounce and add a small telemetry event for failed schema parses (capture sdk_version, route, raw_snippet).

ci-bot: PR #4412 opened by ruth: "devex-sdk: skip safe_wrap in json_mode and add parseStrictJSON" — CI queued.

infra-bot: ticket-5833 created: "AuthRefresher: serialize token refresh and improve retry clarity" assigned to infra.

mike: Short-term workaround in quickstart README: export REDWOOD_SDK_SKIP_SAFE_WRAP=1. We'll remove after patch release. Also add a troubleshooting blurb showing how to surfacing raw responses for debugging.

ana: tagging eng-ml to confirm we won't lose necessary markdown in other flows if we skip safe_wrap in structured responses.

leo: After PR, plan: release patch devex-sdk, bump sample-app template, post note in #devex and #dev-help.

mike: Thanks all — tracking in our little runbook: helper fix, parseStrictJSON, auth debounce, quickstart bump. Ping if CI fails.
